document.about: Western Digital WD Gold data sheet (4 pages). Pp2–4 each set a spec table of six columns ruled with horizontals alone, drawn a column at a time, under a header and section bands shaded a cell at a time with no rule over or under them.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#133): the spec tables came out as fragments and loose paragraphs. The logo's strokes at the page foot trimmed the page-wide grid to its last rows; the bands, drawn as one fill path, were one fill the size of the table, so the grid lumped rows and was read from its text; and the shaded header over the first rule was left out.

checks.issue: #133: `Formatted capacity 1` was a paragraph apart from its values. (#322: a note's number is now written raised, `Formatted capacity¹`.)
#133: `3.5-inch`, `Helium` and the other words were loose paragraphs.
#133: every `5 years` was a loose paragraph. (#322: a note's number is now written raised, `Limited Warranty³`.)
#133: as above, on p4, where labels were fused with values (`Formatted capacity 1 8TB`). (#322: a note's number is now written raised, `Formatted capacity¹`.)
